title: IOOMNI 8
description: I'm Out Of Modpack Name Ideas ! 8. A tech-focused kitchen sink modpack.
body:
**I'm Out Of Modpack Name Ideas is a series of kitchensink modpacks.
This is the first publicly listed version of the modpack do not ask about the seven others.**

# IOOMNI 8
IOOMNI 8 is a 26.1.2 kitchen sink modpack designed primarely for survival gameplay.
while the modpack has a focus around technology, it offers plenty of content for every type of player.

## Tech
- Automate everything with mods like Ender IO, Applied Energistics, Energized Power and their addons.
- Control every variable with ComputerCraft and Integrated Dynamics.
- Say goodbye to manual mining with Additional Enchanted Miner.
  
## Magic
- Make powerful trinkets with Reliquary Reincarnations.
- Become Evil with EvilCraft.
- Explore forbidden magic with Forbidden and Arcanus.
- Get the perfect enchantments with Enchanting Infuser.

## Exploration
- Explore new dimensions with Aether II and Tropicraft.
- Find tons of new mobs with Animal Garden and bring a spyglass to complete your Field Guide!
- Walk through beautiful terrain thanks to Cascades, Biomes O' Plenty, Ecologics and Continents.

## Building
- Access a massive palette of blocks from Stoneworks, BetterBlockZ, Chisel Reborn and Factory Blocks and many more.
- Build any shape with any block with FramedBlocks!
- Decorate your home with Macaw's Mods and Bibliocraft Legacy.

And much, much more.

### Legal
This modpack includes [Extended AE](https://github.com/GlodBlock/ExtendedAE), [Applied Flux](https://github.com/GlodBlock/ExtendedAE/tree/appflux/26.1.2-neoforge) and [Glodium.](https://github.com/GlodBlock/Glodium) Click the relevant link to access their source code and license information.
